title: SourceRange
description: A contiguous range of source code identified by start and end positions. Used to pinpoint where an entity or relationship originates in the source file.

startLine.description: 1-based line number where the range begins.

startColumn.description: 0-based column offset where the range begins.

endLine.description: 1-based line number where the range ends.

endColumn.description: 0-based column offset where the range ends.
